title: BITXpay merchant webhook delivery
description: Generated from notification payload DTOs and event constants. Optional fields may be omitted; consumers should tolerate new fields.

event_code.description: Same event code as the outer event_type.

customer_email.description: Notification recipient email; may be the latest payer, customer, or merchant depending on the producer.

merchant_name.description: Merchant display name when supplied by the producer.

link_id.description: Payment link UUID for link creation; INV-... display reference for engine payment status events.

payment_id.description: Payment link UUID for engine payment events; dispute UUID for refund events. See event notes.

amount.description: Amount string in this event's currency; see event notes for denomination.

currency.description: Amount denomination, which can be an invoice currency or a paid token symbol depending on the event.

transaction_hash.description: Transaction hash when available; may be an empty string.

network.description: Network name, or chain ID as a string when a name cannot be resolved.

asset.description: Producer-supplied asset/network label; currently empty for engine success/failure notifications.

fees.description: Producer-supplied fee string; currently empty for engine success/failure notifications.

received_at.description: Producer event time; engine success uses Go Time.String(), not the outer RFC 3339 format.
